summary: Quiet St Lucia street kerb at the flat bottom end; homes about 20 m off.
reasons: Flat only at the bottom 12 m

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 20-23 m away on the west side, houses all round within 25 m; no bush backing.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed street; grass and gravel verge on the opposite side, little room on the west edge.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential dead-end style street, low traffic.
drivers.convention: A car is parked on the east verge, but signs are 2P resident permit zone Mon-Fri 7am-6pm.

flags: Steep above 15 m: up to about 20% grade
Dense tree cover hides the kerb edge
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy to the west and south-west; shaded afternoons.
cannot_judge: Whether the narrow lane leaves passing room

best_section.where: Bottom end of the west kerb, where Tenth Avenue bends, before it climbs
